_comment: Wheel extension, adjacency MEASURED from the PS1 console port (maintainer video, 2026-08-05) and translated BY POSITION: PS1 puts Pyron in vsav's random cell and random at the very bottom; we keep random at 0x0B and put Pyron at the bottom, so those two rows swap. Positions snapped to vsav's own lattice (14z-60o).
_art_note: tile/attr copied from vsav2's own newcomer wheel record (PRG:0x2A6E52, entries 21-23). The tile CODES are placeholders until the art is placed in our gfx; the palette rows (0x13/0x11/0x05) are vs2 rows that vsavj uses for other characters, so colours will be off until the palette work lands. Maintainer: imperfect medallion art is acceptable, mechanical soundness is not.
_coord_note: 14z-62i (maintainer round 2: 'the three medallions don't show at all', both emulators): the record's coordinate pairs are RELATIVE to the wheel drawer object's base, measured (256,176) — back-computed from Jedah's medallion (pair (-20,-119), OBJ (236,57)) and confirmed on Gallon's 3x3 (pair (8,-112), OBJ (264,64)). The cells' 'pos' values are RING-CENTRE coordinates; the sprite-corner offset for a 3x2 medallion is (-12,-7) (Jedah's empirical). The generator converts: pair = pos + corner_offset - obj_base. The raw positions had been appended verbatim, landing the three entries at OBJ x=480-528/y=344-352 — emitted every frame, never on screen, invisible to every RAM-basis gate.
_highlight_base_note: 14z-63: the ring/highlight drawer ($FFBA00) takes its per-cell base from the 32-row pc-relative word-pair table at PRG:0x5FAE2 (variant half a byte-identical alias of the base half in vsav, exactly like TABLE B; vs2's own variant half is UN-aliased with its newcomers' bases — this fix replicates Capcom's move). Transform, measured on two independent cases (the misplaced b000 bar; Jedah's row-0x0F ring): OBJ_x = base_x + record_coord_x + 64, OBJ_y = 224 - (base_y + record_coord_y). Bases here derive from the row-0x0F reference (base (192,184), measured ring centre (248,64)): base = (pos_x - 56, 248 - pos_y) — i.e. a record positioned like Jedah's ring lands centred on this cell's ring-centre 'pos'. The interim composed b000 bar (5x1, coord (-40,-16)) draws ~8px right of centre with these bases; exact bar-centring would use pos_x - 64. Decision pending (maintainer): ring reuse vs bar vs authored art.
_pal_note: 14z-63 (maintainer round: Phobos/Pyron medallions unreadable): the appended entries' vs2 attr pal rows (0x13/0x11/0x05) are SHARED vanilla medallion rows on vsavj's select screen, so the art rendered under wrong palettes. Fix (bank5/group-C builds only): each cell declares pal_row (a select-screen palette row measured FREE: unreferenced by any OBJ on select frames across 3 replays incl. 2P + challenger-join, AND a live poke-probe of rows 0x00/0x02/0x16/0x19 to loud solids changed ZERO pixels) and pal_src (the vs2 ROM row holding that character's REAL medallion palette, found by matching vs2's live select palette RAM at f1250 de-alpha'd: Donovan 0x3BAFDC = the med_pal_row14 source, Pyron 0x3BB15C, Phobos 0x3BB19C — vs2 block base 0x3BAF3C + row*0x20). The generator rewrites the record entries' pal bits and writes the vs2 rows into vsavj select block A (base 0x3A3800, the wheel view's live copy — rows 0x16/0x19/0x00 verified to load 1:1 into palette RAM; row 0x02 does NOT, its live copy comes from 0x3B5940, hence not used). Row 0x1A avoided: it is the P2-tenant sword row (62k). FINAL ALLOCATION (14z-64): all three medallions ride thunk-protected vestigial MID ROWS of the figure families — Donovan 0x16, Phobos 0x19, Pyron 0x1A — the marchers' writes to all three are redirected to the scratch row 0x02 at the two select-side dest computations (select-gated). Row 0x00 was tried and REVERTED: block A row 0 leaks to the game-over starfield (legacy pixel violation, measured). KNOWN RESIDUAL: row 0x1A is also the P2 sword-accent row (the 62k thunk writes it while P2 hovers the tenant), so Pyron's placeholder medallion shows accent colors after a 2P Donovan hover until screen re-entry — documented trade, narrowest available.
_pos_nudge_note: 14z-63 rounds 9-10 (maintainer): Phobos 10px left total (224->216->214; the last 2 trade lattice fit for ring fit — ratified), Pyron 4px left (248->244). highlight_base moves with pos (base_x = pos_x - 56) so the hover rings stay centred.
